evidence.claim: Method: 3D-wavelet/RGB decoder and importance-selected latent-decoder modulation. Eight named baselines (despite text saying seven): HiDDeN, WAM, Blind, REVMark, Stable Signature, WOUAF, VideoShield, VideoMark. Panda-70M: 10K training videos; Vidprom:100 prompts;100 messages; Open-Sora/DynamiCrafter. Attacks: image distortions, frame manipulations, H.264, weight noise/pruning/retraining. Ablations: modulation, transforms, fusion, patches. Quality: PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS/tLP/FVD;100-person AMT study. Formal security guarantee and calibrated false-positive analysis: UNKNOWN. Code: https://github.com/kuai-lab/TIFS26_lvmark .

evidence.claim: Method: pose-dependent spherical frequency patterns and Fourier projection-slice derivation. Nine image baselines: HiDDeN, MBRS, CIN, FIN, TrustMark, Robust-Wide, InvisMark, WAM, VINE; three 3D comparators: GaussianMarker, GuardSplat,3D-GSW. Data: Synthetic NeRF(8 scenes), LLFF(8), Mip-NeRF360(9);600 rendered views, five repeats,95% intervals. Instant-NGP/TensoRF/3DGS; six image manipulations. PSNR/SSIM/LPIPS, ROC/AUC and TPR at validation-calibrated 1% FPR. Ablations/strength sweeps reported; human study UNKNOWN. Synthetic 3DGS TPR .941 at alpha .4,1.000 at .8; Mip360 .742/.942. Code: https://github.com/luo-ziyuan/MantleMark .

evidence.claim: Method: frozen image decoder; generator watermark-loss averaging over random weight perturbations. Comparators: Yu et al., Fei et al.; StegaStamp for image attacks (three methods). Six datasets/tasks: FFHQ70K, Photo2Monet8231, ADE20K22210, CelebA-HQ30K,VOC2012(count ambiguous),SIDD30K; evaluation n UNKNOWN. Attacks: pruning,quantization,weight noise,fine-tuning,surrogate models,image distortions. Theory: binomial false-alarm/miss model assumes independent bits; not empirical extreme-tail validation. Ablations: perturbation number/range. Quality:FID/PSNR; human study UNKNOWN. StyleGAN2 FID5.28 to5.36; surrogate accuracy .722-.793. Code release UNKNOWN.

evidence.claim: Method: style-feature mean modulation,multi-scale embedding,distribution-squeeze loss,decoder-only second-stage training. Five baseline families: HiDDeN,MBRS,FakeTagger,PIMoG,FIN (seven rows including pretrained variants). MSCOCO/WikiArt:2000 training,500 validation,500 test pairs. AdaIN training; six unseen AST models:SANet,CCPL,EFDM,MccSTN,MANet,CAP. Attacks:style transfer,eight pixel distortions,postprocessing,overwriting. Ablations:network,residual,squeeze loss,fine-tuning,payload. PSNR35.632/SSIM.952; unseen-model bit accuracy .821-.904.
